short.text: This is an at-home observation, not a medical diagnosis. If you're worried about your cat, ask a veterinarian.

medium.title: Keep in mind when reading this chart
medium.text: This chart helps you notice changes compared with your own cat's usual pattern. CatCheck supports at-home monitoring; it does not diagnose disease and does not replace a veterinary examination. A result outside the reference range doesn't mean your cat is ill; likewise, a result within the reference range doesn't rule out illness. Bring this history along to vet visits — it gives the vet more information.

long.title: CatCheck helps you monitor, not diagnose
long.intro: CatCheck records the color of the indicator granules in the litter tray and tracks changes over time. What you see in the app is observational information for reference only — not a lab test result, not a medical diagnosis, and not a replacement for an examination or tests at a veterinary clinic.
bullets: Color can be affected by many factors other than your cat's health: room lighting, the phone camera, shooting angle, food, water, current medications, humidity, and how long the litter has been in contact with urine.

A single result doesn't say much. What matters is the trend — repeated changes compared with your own cat's usual level. When you see an unusual result, the common approach is to keep monitoring for another 24–48 hours, except in the emergencies listed below.

CatCheck doesn't know which cat just used the tray. If you have several cats, you need to choose the right profile yourself before saving a result. If you're not sure, skip that entry — data attached to the wrong cat is noisier than no data at all.
A result within the reference range doesn't mean your cat is completely healthy. Many health problems don't change the properties of urine.
long.closing: Every decision about your cat's health should be made together with a veterinarian. Think of CatCheck as a monitoring diary to bring to vet visits, not something that answers in place of a vet.

emergency.title: Signs that need a vet RIGHT AWAY — don't wait and watch
emergency.intro: Take your cat to a veterinary clinic immediately if you notice:
bullets: Your cat strains a lot but passes no urine, or only a few drops.
Your cat cries, yowls or seems in pain when using the litter box.
Your cat keeps going in and out of the tray but it stays dry.
Your cat stops eating, vomits, is very lethargic, or has a hard, swollen belly.
emergency.closing: A urinary blockage is an emergency and can be life-threatening within 24–48 hours. In these cases, don't use CatCheck to keep watching — call the nearest veterinary clinic.

footerLine.text: CatCheck supports at-home health monitoring — it does not diagnose disease or replace a veterinarian.

dataRequests.intro: This page explains how to exercise your rights over your personal data under the Personal Data Protection Law No. 91/2025/QH15 and Decree 356/2025/ND-CP.

known.label: Right to be informed
known.description: Know about the processing of your personal data, unless the law provides otherwise.
known.sla: Ongoing obligation — see the Privacy policy for details.

consent.label: Right to give / withdraw consent
consent.description: Give or withdraw consent for each data processing purpose.
consent.sla: Response within 02 working days · Fulfilled within 15 days (20 days if via a third party).

viewEdit.label: Right to access and correct data
viewEdit.description: View and request correction of inaccurate personal data.
viewEdit.sla: Response within 02 working days · Fulfilled within 10 days (15 days if via a third party).

export.label: Right to request a copy (export) of data
export.description: Receive a copy of your personal data in a readable format.
export.sla: Response within 02 working days · Fulfilled within 10 days (15 days if via a third party).

erase.label: Right to request data deletion
erase.description: Request deletion of your account and related personal data.
erase.sla: Response within 02 working days · Fulfilled within 20 days (30 days if via a third party).

restrict.label: Right to restrict / object to processing
restrict.description: Request a pause on analysis, notifications and statistics using your data — your data is kept as is.
restrict.sla: Response within 02 working days · Fulfilled within 15 days (20 days if via a third party).

complain.label: Right to complain, denounce, sue and claim compensation
complain.description: Complain to CatCheck or the competent authority if your rights are violated.
complain.sla: As provided by law on complaints — see the Contact page.

protectionMeasure.label: Right to request data protection measures
protectionMeasure.description: Ask CatCheck to apply additional protection measures if you have concerns about data security.
protectionMeasure.sla: Response within 02 working days · Fulfilled within 15 days.

dataRequests.slaNote: Timeframes are counted from when the request is submitted following the procedure below.

howToSubmit.selfService: Do it yourself in the app (recommended) — in the Privacy center in your account.
howToSubmit.webForm: Fill in the complaint form on the Contact page.
howToSubmit.email: Email the data protection officer (DPO) directly — see the address on the Contact page.

dataRequests.loginToSubmit: Sign in to submit a request
dataRequests.verificationTitle: Information to provide and identity verification
dataRequests.verificationDescription: If you're signed in, we verify you through that session (and may ask you to re-verify with a code sent to your email). If you can't sign in, please provide your registered email and describe your request via the Contact channel — CatCheck will get back to you to verify your identity before processing.
dataRequests.rejectionTitle: When a request may be refused
dataRequests.rejectionDescription: CatCheck may refuse all or part of a request if fulfilling it would infringe the rights or legitimate interests of others, or if it falls under cases where the law allows refusal. When we refuse, we always tell you the reason clearly.
dataRequests.trackingTitle: How to check your request status
dataRequests.trackingDescription: Each request gets a reference code in the format DSAR-XXXX-XXXXXX. You can view its status and deadlines in the Privacy center in your account.

complaints.intro: CatCheck handles your complaints through the process below. At this stage, each complaint gets a tracking code and is handled by email with the data protection officer (DPO).

steps.emailDetails: Email a detailed description of your complaint to the DPO (address on the Contact page), including the tracking code you received.
steps.wait: CatCheck responds within 02 working days of receiving complete information.

privacyCenter.title: Privacy center
privacyCenter.intro: See what data CatCheck holds about you, turn each processing purpose on or off, get a copy of your data, and request account deletion.

deletionBanner.title: Your account is pending deletion
deletionBanner.body: Request {{publicRef}} was recorded at {{receivedAt}}. The system will carry out the deletion on {{scheduledAt}}.
deletionBanner.graceNote: During the {{days}}-day grace period, you can still cancel the request and your account returns to normal. After that, it can't be undone.
deletionBanner.derivedNote: The execution date shown here is calculated as the request date plus 7 days (p15 §15.4.6). The API doesn't return the deletion_scheduled_at field directly yet.
deletionBanner.cancelled: Deletion request cancelled. Your account is back to normal.
deletionBanner.expired: The grace period has passed — the request can no longer be cancelled.

consent.title: Data processing purposes
consent.intro: Each purpose is a separate choice — you turn each one on or off; CatCheck doesn't bundle them into a single box.
consent.sourceNote: The status below is read directly from the consent ledger on the server, not inferred by your browser.
consent.appendOnlyNote: Each time you turn something on or off, the system APPENDS a new line to the evidence ledger. Old lines are never edited or deleted — that's how we prove what you agreed to and when.
consent.mandatoryNote: This purpose is part of the core service you signed up for, so it can't be turned off separately. To stop entirely, use Delete account below.
consent.noneHint: Not yet asked doesn't mean consent.
consent.empty: No processing purposes have been configured yet.
consent.saveError: Couldn't save the change. Please try again.
consent.mandatoryError: This required purpose can't be withdrawn.
consent.unknownPurposeError: This purpose is no longer valid. Please reload the page.
consent.evidenceMissing: p15 §15.3.1 (C6) requires that you can download your consent in a printable, copyable format. PrivacyController doesn't have an endpoint returning that file yet. In the meantime, the Get a copy of your data section below includes a consents.json file in the ZIP package.

history.title: Consent history
history.intro: The evidence ledger is append-only: no edits, no deletions. Newest first.

inventory.title: Data CatCheck holds about you
inventory.intro: This list is built dynamically from the system's data inventory, not hand-written text — when a new field is added to the system, it appears here.
inventory.retentionNote: The API only returns the retention policy code. The written retention period is in the p15 §15.5.1 retention table; no endpoint returns it yet.
inventory.empty: The data inventory hasn't been loaded yet.

export.title: Get a copy of your data
export.intro: CatCheck builds a ZIP package containing your profile, cat list, scan history, consent history and notifications, plus a file explaining each column.
export.sla: Response within 02 working days, fulfilled within 10 days. At most 1 request per 24 hours.
export.linkRule: The download link works once, expires after 72 hours and requires you to be signed in. CatCheck does not send the data package as an email attachment.
export.notReady: The data package isn't ready: the background job that builds it (DataExportJob, p15 §15.4.5) doesn't run at this stage, so there's no file to download yet.
export.rateLimited: You already requested a data export in the last 24 hours. Please try again later.
export.gone: The download link has expired or has already been used.
export.none: You haven't requested a data export yet.

restriction.title: Pause data processing
restriction.intro: Your data is kept as is, but the system only stores it: no analysis, no notifications, no statistics.
restriction.sla: Response within 02 working days, fulfilled within 15 days.
restriction.derivedNote: There's no endpoint to read this status directly yet. The status shown is inferred from whether an open RESTRICT request exists in the list below (p15 §15.4.7).
restriction.alreadyActive: Processing is already paused for this account.

deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.intro: This action can't be undone after 7 days. Please read the section below carefully before continuing.
deletion.immediate1: All sessions are revoked and sign-in is locked — you won't be able to get back into your account.
deletion.immediate2: All reminders are cancelled and push notification subscriptions are deleted immediately.
deletion.immediate3: The system schedules the deletion for 7 days later and sends an email with a cancellation link.
deletion.lostTitle: After 7 days, these are gone for good
deletion.lost1: Your account profile is anonymised: email, full name, phone number and profile photo are removed.
deletion.lost2: All cat profiles, health surveys and photos you took are permanently deleted, including photos still within the 14-day window.
deletion.lost3: Scan history is de-identified: pH readings are kept but no longer linked to you or any cat. If you turned off the algorithm-improvement purpose, this data is permanently deleted.
deletion.lost4: In-app activity logs are permanently deleted.
deletion.keptTitle: What CatCheck is required to keep
deletion.kept1: Consent ledger: kept for another 05 years under a pseudonym — required to prove valid consent was obtained.
deletion.kept2: Rights request (DSAR) records: kept for 05 years in anonymised form.
deletion.kept3: Audit logs: kept for 24 months, linked to a pseudonym instead of your identity.
deletion.kept4: Credit and activation code records: kept for reconciliation, with all free-text content removed.
deletion.backupNote: Data remains in backups for up to 30 days according to the rotation cycle. CatCheck doesn't edit backups because doing so would break their integrity.
deletion.exportFirstTitle: Consider getting a copy of your data first
deletion.exportFirst: Once deleted, it can't be restored. Consider requesting a data export in the section above before continuing.
deletion.confirmEmailLabel: Re-enter your account email to confirm
deletion.confirmEmailMismatch: The email doesn't match the signed-in account.
deletion.alreadyRequested: There is already an open deletion request for this account.
deletion.optionsMissing: p15 §15.4.6 (Phase 2) requires letting you choose whether to keep community content anonymised or delete it entirely. The POST /privacy/account-deletion endpoint doesn't accept any options yet, so that choice isn't shown here.
